exam_session_policy: Full 2026 syllabus coverage; no session-specific timetable is included.
runtime_policy: Record an actual supported Python 3 runtime before executing reference solutions; exact examination-centre runtime is not yet supplied. Do not treat a minor version as a Cambridge requirement without evidence.
bilingual_policy: Both locales required for every authored learner-facing lesson, example explanation, hint, feedback, recap, visual label and event explanation; shared IDs, executable code, fixtures, traces and marking references.
original_exam_language_policy: Preserve the English QP/MS source; label Vietnamese paraphrases or translations as AlgoCore learning support, not official Vietnamese exam material.
source_corpus_policy: All local 2021-2025 Paper 4 variants present at baseline, with QP/MS and SF/report availability recorded. Historical questions require compatibility mapping to syllabus 2026. No 2026 paper availability is assumed.
required_interactivity: Event-driven Action Views for processes with changing state, plus prediction, stepping, replay and appropriate visual support.
delivery_scope: Bilingual learning content, Python reference solutions and offline IDE practice, source-linked exam patterns, event modules integrated into the existing Fumadocs app.
